about: 構図の作例写真を作る指示（英語）。CompositionKind の全37種類。座標は variant 0・縦 3:4 の枠で、左上 (0,0)・右下 (1,1)。CompositionGuide.rawMarks の線と同じ値。generate.mjs が common + kinds[kind] + scenes[n] を1本の文にする。
aspectNote: 全部 3:4 で作る。アプリの作例の枠（CompositionExplanationView・構図のシートの札）は縦 3:4 で、比率の構図も 3:4 の写真の上に切り出し枠を暗がりで重ねて見せる。だから比率の構図は『枠の内側に主題を収める』ように書く。CompositionAIExampleTests も 3:4 しか通さない。
variation: seed は Interactions API の公式文書に載っていないので送らない。候補の違いは scenes の3つ（日本の撮影地と海外の撮影地を混ぜる・光とレンズも変える）で作る。同じ候補を作り直すときは --retake で言い回しの末尾（retakePhrases）を足して揺らす。

common.lead: A single authentic travel photograph, photorealistic, as if shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera. Vertical 3:4 frame.
rules: No person's face is the subject: any people are small in the frame, seen from behind or in silhouette, never a close-up portrait.
No text, letters, signs with readable words, logos, watermarks, borders, captions or frames added to the image.
Do not draw any composition guide lines, grids, arrows or overlays; the composition must come only from the scene itself.
Natural colour and contrast like a carefully edited real photo; avoid HDR halos, oversaturation, plastic skin, CGI or illustration looks.
Do not depict any real, identifiable famous building, landmark, artwork, brand, product or real person; use generic, unnamed places.
Keep the main subject sharp; the placement described above must be exact, because guide lines will be laid over this photo.
retakePhrases: Change the vantage point a little but keep the placement exact.

thirds.lines: verticals at x=0.333 and x=0.667; horizontals at y=0.333 and y=0.667
thirds.placement: Put the main subject exactly on the lower-right intersection of the rule-of-thirds grid (67% from the left, 67% from the top). Any horizon lies along the lower third line (67% from the top). Leave the other three intersections empty.

halves.lines: vertical at x=0.5 and horizontal at y=0.5 (a centered cross)
halves.placement: Split the frame exactly in half at the horizontal center line (50% from the top): the upper half and the lower half are a clear pair (sky and its reflection, or two contrasting tones). Place a small vertical element exactly on the vertical center line (50% from the left).

symmetry.placement: Shoot straight on so the scene is mirror-symmetric around the vertical center line (50% from the left). The central doorway or axis sits exactly on that line; left and right halves balance.

hinomaru.lines: a circle centered at (0.5, 0.5) whose diameter is one third of the frame width, with a small cross at the center
hinomaru.placement: Put one subject dead center (50%, 50%). It fits inside a centered circle about one third of the frame width; the background is simple and uncluttered around it.

horizon.placement: Put the horizon perfectly level exactly on the lower third line (67% from the top), so the sky fills the top two thirds of the frame.

grid4.lines: 4x4 grid: verticals at x=0.25, 0.5, 0.75; horizontals at y=0.25, 0.5, 0.75
grid4.placement: Shoot a facade head-on so its window rows and columns line up with a 4 by 4 grid: vertical edges near 25%, 50% and 75% from the left, horizontal floor lines near 25%, 50% and 75% from the top. Keep all verticals parallel.

squareGrid.placement: Fill the frame with a regular pattern of square cells seen straight on, so the pattern's columns repeat every one sixth of the width and its rows every one eighth of the height.

tianzige.placement: Center the subject on the cross at (50%, 50%) and balance four similar elements in the four quarters, like a calligraphy practice square. Keep a thin clear margin near the edges.

mizige.placement: Shoot straight up or down so strong lines radiate along the vertical, horizontal and both diagonal directions and meet exactly at the frame center (50%, 50%).

phiGrid.lines: verticals at x=0.382 and x=0.618; horizontals at y=0.382 and y=0.618
phiGrid.placement: Place the main subject exactly on the lower-right phi-grid intersection (62% from the left, 62% from the top), closer to the center than a rule-of-thirds point.

goldenSpiral.lines: a golden spiral whose eye is at (0.276, 0.724), sweeping in from the top and right edges
goldenSpiral.placement: Let curving lines (a path, shoreline or stair rail) sweep from the top-right of the frame in a tightening spiral toward the spiral's eye at 28% from the left and 72% from the top. The main subject sits exactly at that eye, not above it.

fibonacciGrid.lines: the square subdivisions of a vertical golden rectangle, shrinking toward (0.276, 0.724)
fibonacciGrid.placement: Build the scene as nested rectangles that shrink toward a point 28% from the left and 72% from the top: large planes at the top, smaller and smaller steps leading down-left to the subject at that point.

goldenTriangle.lines: one diagonal from bottom-left to top-right, and perpendiculars from the other two corners meeting it at (0.64, 0.36) and (0.36, 0.64)
goldenTriangle.placement: Run a strong slope along the diagonal from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner. Put the main subject exactly at 64% from the left and 36% from the top, and a secondary element at 36% from the left and 64% from the top.

diagonals.lines: one diagonal from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner

thirdsDiagonals.lines: rule-of-thirds grid plus both corner-to-corner diagonals
thirdsDiagonals.placement: Diagonal lines in the scene (a road and its edges) follow the frame's diagonals and lead to the main subject placed exactly on the upper-right thirds intersection (67% from the left, 33% from the top). Nothing important sits on the empty center.

diagonal45.lines: four 45-degree lines from each corner: top-left to (1, 0.75), top-right to (0, 0.75), bottom-left to (1, 0.25), bottom-right to (0, 0.25); they cross at (0.5, 0.375) and (0.5, 0.625)
diagonal45.placement: Use lines that are exactly 45 degrees in the picture (rooflines, stair rails, folded paper). Main elements cross at the center line, 37.5% and 62.5% from the top.

obliqueThirds.placement: Divide the scene into slanted bands: a sloped edge runs from 67% down the left edge to 67% along the top edge, and a parallel edge runs from 33% along the bottom to 33% down the right edge.

dynamicSymmetry.lines: both diagonals plus four perpendicular reciprocals; eyes at (0.36,0.36), (0.64,0.36), (0.36,0.64), (0.64,0.64)
dynamicSymmetry.placement: Crossing streets or edges follow both diagonals and their perpendiculars. The main subject sits exactly at an eye point 64% from the left and 36% from the top; secondary elements sit near the other eyes.

armature.lines: both diagonals, a rhombus through the edge midpoints, and lines from each corner to the far edges' midpoints
armature.placement: Shoot a geometric scene head-on so that edges follow the frame diagonals and the diamond that joins the midpoints of the four edges (50% along each edge).

rootRectangle.lines: a √2 crop frame from x=0.028 to x=0.972 (full height) with dynamic-symmetry diagonals inside
rootRectangle.placement: Keep everything important inside the central √2 frame (2.8% margins left and right). A cityscape's main diagonals follow the corner-to-corner lines of that frame.

triangle.placement: Three subjects mark the vertices of a triangle: the top one exactly at 50% from the left and 18% from the top, the lower two exactly at 16% and 84% from the left, both 80% from the top. Use small subjects whose centers sit on those points.
